title: Hospital Stay Charge Computation under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations
content:
The **hospital stay charge** of **Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations** is computed as follows.

The hospital stay charge is the hospital stay entry's charged days times the hospital stay daily charge, rounded half up to the cent once on the total.

The entry is the resident-private entry of a Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold whose leave has ended with a single resident-private entry on the reservation — the reservation's one resident-private entry, the entry with the latest last day on the reservation. A reservation carries one resident-private entry per service month, so the hospital stay entry is a single entry, its days as booked counted net of any of them reversed against it.

The hospital stay daily charge is the schedule daily rate for the tier of the room held, the prior schedule pricing the entry's days dated before the current schedule's schedule date and the current schedule the rest. The prior and current schedule rates of each room tier that price the hospital stay charge are the figures this schedule restates from the private pay schedule, the current schedule taking effect on its schedule date, 2026-07-01.

| Tier of the room held | Prior schedule daily rate (days dated before 2026-07-01), USD | Current schedule daily rate (2026-07-01 onward), USD |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

The current-schedule days are the calendar days from 2026-07-01 through the entry's last day, never more than the entry's days and none where the entry ends before 2026-07-01; every other day of the entry is a prior-schedule day.

The hospital stay entry's charged days are its days less any of them held before the transfer notice was delivered, those days being the entry's days dated before the delivery date, or all of its days where no transfer notice is on file. A transfer notice counts from the earlier of its latest delivery to the resident and its latest delivery to the representative; where it has been delivered to only one of them, that delivery is the one counted.

The figures are combined in this order: each schedule rate is first taken to the applicable percent, any per-day credit is then subtracted from that reduced rate, and each resulting daily charge is multiplied by the charged days it applies to; the days not charged at the start of the entry are its first days, the days not charged at the end of the entry are its last days, and the current-schedule days are counted back from the entry's last day; the charge is the sum, rounded half up to the cent once on the total.

### Worked statement (hypothetical inputs)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Entry | 8 June through 25 June, 18 days booked, 2 reversed: 16 days |
| Room held | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Earlier of the latest transfer-notice deliveries | 10 June (8 and 9 June dated before it) |
| Charged days | 14 |
| Current-schedule days | 0 (the entry ends before 2026-07-01) |
| Prior-schedule charged days | 14 |
| Charge | 14 at 412.00: 5,768.00 |
